visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a vertical close-up of a ginger and white cat resting on a textured cardboard scratcher. A human finger enters the frame and strokes the cat's forehead. The lighting is bright and natural, coming from an indoor source. (2) As the finger strokes its head, the cat yawns widely, exposing its teeth and pink mouth. The camera is steady, and Traditional Chinese subtitles appear at the top and center of the screen to interpret the interaction. (3) The scene cuts to a medium-full shot of an elderly man with grey hair and glasses. He is dressed in a striped grey polo shirt and dark grey sweatpants, standing in a doorway. He raises both hands to his head, meticulously smoothing his hair as if preparing for a photo. (4) The camera alternates between the man talking from the doorway and the cat's reactions in the foreground. The man leans against the doorframe, making hand gestures while holding his glasses. Variety-show style text bubbles and emojis pop up around him to highlight his expressions. (5) The man continues his story, occasionally gesturing toward the hallway. The setting is a clean, modern apartment with wooden floors and light-colored walls. The editing uses quick cuts between the man's face and the cat's unimpressed gaze. (6) In the final phase, the man turns and walks away through the doorway. A close-up of the cat's face is shown one last time as it stares directly into the lens. Final subtitles appear at the bottom center before the video fades.

(3) A male voice with a warm, elderly timbre enters, responding with a mix of pride and mock annoyance. A sharp 'ding' sound effect punctuates his action as he touches his hair. (4) The two voices engage in a rapid back-and-forth dialogue. The speech rate is natural but energetic. Small cartoon 'pop' sound effects trigger when new text appears on screen. (5) As the male speaker describes receiving free food because of the cat, his pitch rises with excitement. The BGM continues smoothly without any breaks or volume ducking. (6) The female narrator teases the man, her voice showing high emotional valence. The male speaker's dominance remains level as he shares his 'lottery' analogy.
